scoring: Score observed controller transitions and executed tools separately from provider labels. A retained ambiguous request with clarification is a safe abstention, not a successful intended transition. Incorrect activation, closure or unsupported factual use is a failure. Provider errors/oversize refusals are incomplete, never passes. Review prose claims against frozen sources; substring checks are diagnostic only. No prompt tuning after dispatch. Visual labels are hypotheses, not certainty. Check feature support, original-question retention, requested constraints, capture count and actual controller actions. The public bird photograph is labeled American robin by its source; safe uncertainty is distinct from wrong identification. No web task execution.
